summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatter lambda (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, which checks only is_terminal, and has a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title). Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests, mypy, and Black were not run, per instructions, so these changes are verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
